ModMetadata.Name: Thermodynamics Solar Heating Addon
ModMetadata.Author: SchwarzFuchs
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Thermodynamics Solar Heating Addon[/h1] [b]Requires:[/b] BepInEx + StationeersLaunchPad.
[b]Companion mod:[/b] Designed as an addon for "Structure Thermodynamics". That mod models heat loss through your walls; this one adds solar heating of the room air. Use them together for a realistic thermal balance — a room settles at an equilibrium temperature where solar gain is offset by the heat lost through the structure. This mod also works standalone (solar gain only, no heat loss).
[b]What it does:[/b] Sun-facing structural panels heat the air of the room they border, computed per wall panel.
[b]Sunlight / occlusion:[/b] A panel only heats when the sun actually reaches it (occlusion-aware ray to the sun). A transparent panel (frame/glass) is tested from its own cell, so lateral overhangs and roof "umbrellas" correctly shade it. A solid, light-blocking wall is tested from the cell outside it, so the wall itself does not block its own light.
[b]Config (LaunchPad in-game settings menu, adjustable at runtime, no restart):[/b] General/solarHeatingMultiplier (default 0.25) — global scale on the heating energy; 1 = realistic level General/glassTransmissionMultiplier (default 1.0) — scale on glass transmissivity (R); 1 = vanilla glass Performance/threadedInterpolation (default off) — heavy compute every 10 ticks on a background thread + interpolation; lowers main-thread load Debug/debugLog (default off) — verbose per-tick [TSHA] diagnostics in the BepInEx log Debug/debugLogInChat (default off) — mirror [TSHA] diagnostics into the in-game console Debug/debugLogInterval (default 10) — debug-line cadence in ticks (1 = every tick) Debug/performanceTrace (default off) — per-stage pipeline timing in the BepInEx log (file: BepInEx/config/ThermodynamicsSolarHeatingAddon.cfg)
[b]Diagnostics (BepInEx LogOutput.log, source TSHA):[/b] tick#N: irr=..W/m2 heated=.. J | notInSun noRoom OK vacuum ATMO: total=.. local=.. withRoom=.. roomMap=.. INNER: (x,y,z) inner=.. -> factor=.. INSUL: (x,y,z) fwd=.. (press Home in game for a one-shot dump)
